marginNote: Price EX GST = net invoice. Price EX GST plus X% markup = net × (1 + X/100). Price INC GST = marked-up ex GST × 1.10.

parse.notes: Excel row 6 is typically the column header row; ingest skips header-like rows. All workbook sheets are scanned; product sheets yield priced parts.

howToRefresh: Drop the new Rinnai price workbook into source-data/ (or update priceList.workbookPath in this file).
Update priceList.effectiveDate and priceList.workbookFile/workbookPath to match the new file.
Restart or refresh the app — search uses public/data/prices.json and public/data/models.json.
Series aliases (HD28 ↔ VCM2837 etc.) are hand-maintained in public/data/series-aliases.json — not overwritten by ingest.
